Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game! Another dominating performance from England and a whitewash is surely on the cards. Australia on the other hand, have tried everything possible but still have not found the winning formula. Will they avoid a whitewash or will England continue their domination? We will find out in the 5th ODI on the 24th at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Till then, take care and goodbye.

Man of the Match, Jason Roy, says he is enjoying his time in this series. He feels he is just focused on doing his job for his team. He mentions he is trying to pace his innings and set a good platform for the batters coming in.

England skipper, Eoin Morgan, feels they played well here. Admits they struggled to take wickets but the run rate was always in check. Mentions a lot depends on conditions and this one was a good wicket to bat on. Adds further at the half way time they were happy with the target. Credits Overton for the way he bowled. Ends by saying a new challenge awaits at Manchester and he hopes to continue the good show over there.

Australian skipper, Tim Paine, says they were at least 30 or 40 short after the platform they got courtesy Finch and Marsh. He feels the dropped catch was the turning point. He adds further they were poor with the ball up front. Ends by saying they have come here with an inexperienced side against the best in the world and hopes they learn a lot from the tour.

After Australia scored 310, courtesy Finch and Marsh's ton, one would have thought they had a real chance of winning. But once again their bowlers were below par. Their pacers were guilty of either bowling too wide, full or short, had high economy rates and only Billy Stanlake managed to pick a wicket. Yes, Paine did drop the catch of Hales but I do not think that would have made a difference. Agar was the pick of the bowlers for them who finished with figures of 8-0-48-2 but lacked support from the other end.

A mockery is what England have made of this run chase. Yes, you have read it right, 311 has been chased down without breaking a sweat. Chasing a big total on a wicket which was slightly two-paced, the English openers once again milked the Australian bowling. Their stand was worth 174 with Jason Roy scoring yet another magnificent ton which came up of just 81 balls. Jonny Bairstow too, continued his good form but could not get his century. The hosts did lose both the openers in quick succession but the job was done by them. They had the game in their pocket and the batters who then walked out ensured there were no great hiccups. Buttler's meaty blows and his fifty was the icing on the cake to round what was another brilliant English performance with the bat.

FOUR! What a way to end the match. Full around off and Buttler stays inside the line and hits it through the line. The sound off the ball meeting the bat will tell you that the ball has raced away to the cover fence. ENGLAND WIN BY 6 WICKETS WITH 32 BALLS TO SPARE.

Full ball on the leg stump, Jos looks to hit down the ground but doesn't get the connection. The ball hangs in the air and the fielder at long on comes in to take the catch and throw it back. Two runs are taken meanwhile. The scores are level and Jos Buttler has reached his half century as well.

No Ball and a SIX! HAAH! This one never touched the ground. Neser looks to bowl a back of the hand slower ball but gets it horribly wrong. It reaches Buttler at the perfect height and he swings his blade like a sword to hit it way behind the mid-wicket fence. Just three needed now with free hit coming up next.
Yorker and kept out the batsman.
FOUR! Oh man, he has a train to catch probably. Neser lands a fuller delivery around off and Jos grinds it through covers. The ball races to the fence for a boundary.
Wide! The ball is way wide on the leg side but the batsman still goes after it and misses.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground with the full face of the bat.
OOH! Where did that come from? Lands on a fullish length, grips and turn and goes through the bat and pad. One run stolen from the fine leg region.
Third defense in tandem. No hurry for Buttler.
Looks to make room but defends it in the end.
Flatter trajectory from Lyon and punched by the batsman for nothing.
Hangs back and punches it off the back foot to long on. One run added to the total.
Nathan Lyon is back into the attack.
Fuller delivery and flicked off the pads. One more run is added to the total and brings up the 50-run stand between the two as well.
FOUR! Now Hales gets into the attack. Width on offer and rightly punished through the backward point region. Third boundary of the over.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Elegant. Brute force and yet so elegant. Gets a length delivery right under his bat and he lofts the cover drive. The ball bounces just inside the fence and goes for the second boundary.
FOUR! Up and over. Full outside off and Jos is upto it this time. Slaps hard at the ball and hits it over the fielder at point and to the fence.
Full outside off, Buttler fails to connect with the delivery.
Michael Neser has been brought back for another spell.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. They pick up a single.
FOUR! WOW! Brilliant, just brilliant! Stanlake goes fuller on off, Buttler strokes it right off the middle and through extra cover for another boundary.
Lands it on a length again on off, Hales drops it towards cover for a quick run.
Shortish and outside off, cut to point.
Good length around off, this one jags back in. Hales tries to keep it out but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
On middle, worked around the corner for a run.
FOUR! Third boundary in the over! Buttler is in a hurry here. This is short and on middle, Jos pulls it over mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, stroked to mid off.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! This is through the off side. Short again and width on offer. Jos cuts it through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Too easy for Buttler, this is short and on middle, Buttler pulls it through square leg and the ball races away to the fence.
Fuller outside off, Hales squeezes it past point for another single.
Fuller in length on off, Buttler drives it to covers where the fielder misfields and a run is taken. Singles will do it for England.
Powerplay 3 has been signaled! Now 5 fielders will be placed outside the ring. Also, Jhye Richardson is back into the attack.
Shortish outside off, this one stays low. Hales goes for the cut but is beaten by the low bounce.
Fuller on off, Buttler drives it through covers for a run.
Shortish, Hales rocks back and pulls it through square leg for a run.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Just over! On a length around off, sticks in the surface. Buttler stops his shot as he tries to drive. It goes uppishly but over covers and the batsmen run two.
Slightly short outside off, Hales guides it down to third man for a run.
Billy Stanlake is back on.

FOUR! Loopy around middle and leg, Jos flicks with the bottom hands and places it between the gap. The fielder from mid-wicket runs after it but the pure timing gets it to the wide long off fence with ease.
Hangs back in his crease and blocks it out.
Almost a yorker. Jos digs it out.
Uppish but safe. Plants his foot down the pitch and lofts the tossed up delivery to the long on region. One run results.
Plays it down the ground for nothing.
Floated around off and middle, Hales keeps it out from the front foot.
Back of a length wide of off, Buttler cuts it to the left of the point fielder. Sweeper cover comes around and keeps it down to two.
Stays back and keeps it out from the crease.
Gets forward and gets it through the covers. One run results.
Gets behind the line, blocked.
Back of a length, Buttler gets back and punches it through sweeper cover. Another single taken.
A length delivery around off, Hales creams it through covers for a single.
Jhye Richardson is back for another spell.
Jos Buttler is the next man in.

OUT! There is an edge! Morgan walks back and takes England's sole review along with him. Another wicket for Agar. He fires this one outside off. Morgan slashes at it and edges it to Paine who takes it and appeals. The umpire raises his finger but Morgan feels he has not hit it and goes for the review. Replays show there is a spike on Snicko and Eoin is given his marching orders. Australia still in it. England need another 67 in 78 balls with 6 wickets in hand.
Morgan is given caught behind but he wants it to be reviewed. There was a noise as the ball passed the bat. However, a batsman knows most of the times whether he has hit it or not. Let us see.
Again a boundary is followed by a couple. This is cut through point and the batsmen run two.
FOUR! Catch it was the call but there was no fielder there. Floats it up outside off, Morgan clears mid off and the ball races away to the fence. 69 more needed.
Strokes this through covers now and bags a brace.
FOUR! Brilliant! Even though the bowler knows it is coming, he can't do a lot about it. Morgan plays the reverse sweep to perfection and it races away to the backward point fence.
Drives it back to the bowler.
Length again but on middle, Morgan tucks it around the corner and gets to the other end.
On a length around off, Morgan strikes it to covers.
Another length ball outside off, Hales guides it down to third man for a run.
Fuller and attacks the stumps, it is driven to mid off.
A little too straight by the bowler, he flicks it through square leg for a run.
Goes fuller in length on off, it is driven to the man at covers.
Slightly shorter on middle, Morgan goes back and punches it through mid on for a run.
Eoin Morgan is the new man in.

OUT! Root has been uprooted! You miss, I hit says Ashton Agar. Australia fighting hard here. This is fired on the stumps, Root tries to sweep it but misses the ball completely and sees the furniture behind get shattered. Joe falls after getting a start. England need another 83 from 91.
Driven towards the mid on region.
Driven down to long on for a run.
Flatter on off, pushed to covers.
Eases it down to mid off for a run.
Length again on off, this one stays a touch low. Hales does really well to keep it out. Stoinis should be watching how Alex played that.
Fuller in length on off, kept out.
Guides it down to third man for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
Back of a length on off, Root guides it to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Root picks his spot to perfection! Short and on middle, Root rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a one bounce boundary.
Eases it down to long off for a run.
Drives it back to the bowler.
SIX! Right in the slot for Root! Full and on middle, Joe clears his front leg and slog sweeps it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Flatter on middle, it is guided to point.
Very full on off, Hales squeezes it through point for a run.
Tosses it up on off, Hales drives it to covers.
Ashton Agar is back on.

FOUR! Once again the last ball spoils the over! Fuller on middle, Root walks down the track and drives it towards the bowler. He tries to stop it with his foot but deflects it towards mid on. The fielder there puts in a dive but fails to stop it and the ball races away. The runs needed are below 100.
Back of a length on off, defended to point.
Fuller on off, it is strokes to mid on.
Punched through covers for a run.

DROPPED! The skipper, the culprit. The Aussies needed that to be taken. It was a regulation catch. On a length around off, this one straightens a touch. Takes the edge as Hales tries to defend. Goes low towards Paine who dives forward to take it but fluffs it. How costly will this prove?
On the shorter side outside off, Hales punches it through covers and gets a brace.
Michael Neser is back into the attack.
Back of a length on off, Hales guides it through point for a run.
Works it around the corner for a run.
Works it through square leg for a run.
FOUR! The slower ball but it is very short. Hales somehow manages to drag his pull over the mid-wicket fielder and into the fence.
The batsman plays the pull shot. They pick up a single.
Fuller in length on off, Root drives it back to the bowler.
A single from the last ball which means no maiden. Short and outside off, Root plays the upper cut. The ball goes to third man and the batsmen take a run.
Back of a length on off, Root hops and defends it onto the ground.
OUCH! This was quick and on the shorter side. Root goes for the pull but misses to get hit on the body.
Slightly fuller on off, Root leans into it and drives it to the man at covers.
Works it with the angle to the man at mid-wicket.
Spears it on a length around off, Root defends it to covers.
Slightly shorter on off, Hales pushes it to mid off. End of a good over by Stoinis.
Very full on off, Hales jams it out towards mid off.
Little bit of shape into the batsman from outside off. Root flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Once again lands it on a length around off, Hales tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket for a run.
On a length around middle, it is pushed to the man at mid on.
Bowls it on the pads, Hales tries to flick but misses. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head.
Marcus Stoinis is back on.
Length again on middle, Joe defends it onto the ground. 116 more needed in 22 overs.
A snorter! Comes steaming in and bowls a bumper and a very well-directed one. Root does well to take his gloves out of the way at the very end.
Fuller in length on off, Root drives it to mid off.
On a length around off, Root taps it towards covers and wants a run but is sent back.
Slightly shorter outside off, Root gets on top of the bounce and guides it through point for a couple.
A good short ball on the body of the batsman. Root does well to nudge it through square leg for a brace.
Back of a length on off, Hales guides it to point.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
FOUR! Streaky! Full ball outside off, Hales tries to jam it out but gets an inside edge which goes past the diving keeper and into the fine leg fence.
Back of a length on off, Root pushes it through covers and takes a single.
A little wide outside off, Root need not play at those.
Goes fuller in length on off, Hales drives it through covers and gets to the other end.
Almost! On a length and around off, this straightens after pitching. Root has to play at it but gets beaten by the movement. End of an excellent over by Stanlake.
Edged but well short! Back of a length on off, Root tries to punch it through the off side but the ball takes the outside edge and goes on the bounce to the slip fielder who makes a good stop.
Slightly short outside off, Hales cuts it through point and gets to the other end.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Back of a length on off, Root guides it through point for a run.
Joe Root walks out to the middle.

OUT! One brings two and that is exactly what Australia needed. The bowling change has done the trick as Billy Stanlake strikes off the very first ball of his new spell. It is a short ball outside off, Bairstow tries to guide it down to third man but it goes off the glove to the right of Paine who takes it with a dive. So no ton today for Bairstow as he falls 21 short. Can Australia take another quickly?
Billy Stanlake is back on.
Fuller delivery outside off, Jonny carves it through covers and keeps the strike for the next over.
On a good length on off, the batsman presents the full face of the bat and keeps it out.
Full and wide, Hales digs it to the vacant point region. Another easy single for the hosts.
Short of a length in to the body, the batsman swivels and tucks it to the mid-wicket region for another single.

Almost a copy paste stuff. A touch closer to the off stump this time and Jonny happy to stay on his leg side and power it through the cover-point region. The fielder stationed at backward point dives to his right but couldn't cut it out. Two more added to the total.
Back of a length outside off, Bairstow slaps it to behind point off the back foot and takes two.
Jhye Richardson is into the attack.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Floats it up on off, it is pushed through covers for a run.
Alex Hales is the new man in.

OUT! Lyon breaks through! How much did Australia need this? He tosses this up once again outside off, Roy looks to go big yet again. He fails to do so as the ball takes the outside edge and then goes towards short third man where Shaun Marsh takes it easily. End of the 174-run stand, the highest at Chester-le-Street. Roy walks off to a standing ovation as he has done his job. England need another 137.
Tucks it through the leg side and gets to the other end.
Works this around the corner and gets to the other end.

SIX! What a way to get his century! Another outstanding knock by the English opener and the way he celebrates it just shows how much it means to him. He runs towards Jonny and gets a bear hug from him. Looks at the heaven and then acknowledges the applause from the crowd. Now to the delivery - It is tossed up on middle, Roy skips down the track, gets to the pitch of it and lofts it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full outside off and the batsman flashes hard only to get and outside edge. The fielder at third man dives to his left and stops the ball.
FOUR! Touch too straight and Bairstow flicks it through mid-wicket for an easy boundary.
Powers it down the ground and takes another single.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Full outside off, Bairstow goes for the full blooded cut but manages to get an outside edge. The ball lobs in the air for a while but doesn't reach the fielder at short third man at full, who does well to cut it out.
Wide outside off and tucked to the off side. One run taken.
Punches it down the long on boundary and takes a single to keep the strike for the next over.
Flatter delivery around middle off, Bairstow works it down the leg side. One more runs added to the total.
Hangs back and dabs it behind point for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Tries the sweep but misses the ball as it hits his pads outside off.
Tossed up around off, Roy gets forward and blocks it out.
Width outside off and carved through the point region. They scamper for two and makes it easily.
Fuller around off and pushed through covers for another single.
On a length around off, Bairstow gets in the gap between cover fielders and runs a single.
Inside edge onto his pads and the ball rolls to the leg side. One more run taken.

FOUR! Up and over. Full on stumps and Roy powers it over the infield. The fielder at long on had no chance to cut it out as the ball goes to the fence. This the second consecutive 150 for the pair in the series.
Short and pulled to backward square leg region for a single.
A touch shorter in length and the batsman rocks back and keep sit out for nothing.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Tossed up around middle and leg , Roy gets back and cuts it square behind point. A brace added to the total.
Gets forward and drives it back to the bowler.

Tosses it up outside off, this one turns back in. Roy lunges and tries to push but is done in by the turn into him. He seems to have missed it and the ball hits him on the pads. The players appeal but the umpire shakes his head. Paine has a chat with his bowler and then decides not to use the review. Good call by the two as Snicko later on shows there was a spike as the ball passed the bat.
Flighted around off and swept fine for a single from the square leg region.
Drinks has been called. Time for some breather.
Works the fullish delivery towards mid-wicket. Two more runs taken. They are running away with this run chase here.
Wide! Too high from Marcus and wide signaled by the umpire.
Another full ball around off, the batsman has driven it to mid off. One run is taken.
Yorker! He does well to dig it out and get it to mid off for a single.
Top edge! Good ball by the bowler. The batsmen have run through for a single.

NOT OUT! A back of  length around off, Jason cuts it and runs for the single. His partner obliges and off they go. The fielder at short cover hits the stumps on the full and they appeal. The umpire goes upstairs to check and replays show Bairstow is home. Good running from the duo.
Third umpire is called up for the run out decision.
Too full and driven straight down the ground. The fielder at long on makes a diving save and saves two for his team.
The batsman drives the ball straight down the ground.
FOUR! OOH! Could have been close had he missed but good for him, he didn't. Flighted ball around middle and leg, the batsman gets down on his knee and sweeps it fine for another boundary.
Shows the full face of the bat and keeps it out.
Touch short Outside off, Bairstow waits for it and cuts it square. One run added to the total.
Touch short, Jonny gets back and punches it through the off side for another single.
Flighted around off, Roy comes down the track and hits it to long on region for a single.
Another change in bowling. Nathan Lyon comes back into the attack.
Gets a length ball on leg and tucks it to the leg side, where the fielder has a shy at the stumps but the replays show that the batsman would have made into his crease.
It's been driven superbly through the covers. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full on the stumps and driven to mid off region for nothing.

Serves this one a good length around off and Jonny with his 'golf like swings' connects the ball nicely. The ball races to the fence at mid-wicket but the wicket stationed there runs to his left and cuts it down to two.
Too short to contain Roy. He gets into position and slaps it to the fielder at deep mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Back of a length outside off, blocked off the back foot.
Marcus Stoinis is into the attack.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Flighted around off and Roy changes his stance and reserve sweeps it fine. The ball races to the third man boundary.
Fifty for Bairstow now. Once again both the openers have brought their fifties up. Jonny pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.
A half tracker this from Agar. Bairstow is quick to rock back in his crease and punches the ball uppishly to the fielder at sweeper cover. Two run results.
Waits for the slower delivery and punches it through cover-point region for another single.
Pushed around off and punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
In the air... but short! A lofted straight drive off the full ball. The ball hangs in the air for a while and bounces in front of the fielder at mid on.
Drags his length back a touch and Jason cuts it straight to the fielder at point.
FOUR! On a length outside off, a lot of width and Roy is in no mood to let these go. He loses his shape but still manages to power it through the mid-wicket region for another boundary.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a good length outside off, the batsman looks to cut it but misses it.
FOUR! Not good from Billy. A half tracker in to the ribs and Bairstow is quick to swivel and crack it through square leg region for a boundary.
Billy Stanlake is back for a burst.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Loopy around middle, Roy comes down the track and lifts it over the fielder at short cover, who attempts to stop the ball with a desperate leap in the air  but he is nowhere near it. One run taken.
Tossed up around off, Roy getting an outside to the third man region.
Touch short and guides through cover-point. One run added to the total.
Flatter on off and pushed to the vacant cover region. Two runs are taken and 100 is up for England.
Flighted around middle and off, Roy works it to the point region and runs for a single.
Pushes it to mid off and sets off for a run. There is a chance of a run out had the fielder picked the ball up but he fails to do so.
Just behind a length on off, Jonny pushes it towards covers. The fielder there makes a half-stop and the batsmen run a single.
A slower ball outside off, JB tries to slap it through the off side but gets beaten.
On a length around off, Jonny goes too hard at it and mistimes it to covers.
FOUR! Shot of the day! Lovely, so pleasing to the eye! On a length and on middle, Bairstow shows the full face of the bat and times it back past the bowler for a boundary.
On a length around off, Roy strokes it on the up through covers and gets to the other end.
Eases it down to long off for a run. A good over by Agar just three from it. They though need to keep bowling such tight overs.
Works it with the angle through square leg for a run.
Slower through the air on off, Roy pushes it through covers and gets to the other end.
Third dot in a row! Flatter and on off, Roy cuts it to point.
Fires it on the pads, Roy looks to tuck it around the corner but misses to get hit on the pads.
Floats it up on off, Roy drives it to covers.
FOUR! No breathing space for the Aussie bowlers. A gentle full ball outside off and punched through wide mid off and away from the diving fielder stationed there. 11 runs off the over.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
FOUR! The 'Jason Roy' show is here! On a good length outside off and Roy guides it to the right side of the diving fielder and collects another boundary.
On middle and leg, Roy keeps it out off the back foot.
Width on offer and played with hard hands. The ball runs off the outer edge and goes to third man.
On a fullish length around off, an inside edge on to his pad and the ball goes to the leg side. One run taken.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled. Australia can keep four fielder outside the circle now.
Floats this one up on off, JB finds the man at covers.
Jonny drives it straight back to the bowler.
Jonny makes room, Agar follows him. Bairstow goes for the pull but is done in by the low bounce.
Fires it on the stumps, Bairstow cuts it to point.
Fifty for Roy, it has been another power-packed innings by the opener. He eases this down to long on and reaches that milestone.

NOT OUT! Agar tosses this one up on off, he gets it to turn ever so slightly. Roy tries to keep it out off the front foot but gets beaten. Paine behind the stumps whips the bails off and appeals. The umpire takes it upstairs and replays show that Roy never lifted his leg.
A stumping appeal has been taken upstairs. No Australian fielder looks excited.
FOUR! Slashes and slashes hard. Jonny line up the shortish delivery as he moves to the leg side. The ball goes off the top edge and runs to the third man boundary.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
Short of a length around off, the batsman blocks it to the off side.
Bouncer! Bairstow ducks in time to let that one go over him.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! This is getting embarrassing for Australia now. A gentle half tracker outside off, Jonny stays to the leg side and gets it between cover-point. The boundary races to the fence. Richardson starts his spell with a boundary.
FOUR! Spoils the over! Slightly shorter and offers juts a little width outside off, Roy goes back and cuts it through cover-point for another boundary. He moves onto 49.
Floats it up on off, kept out.
Good bowling! Loopy ball on off, Roy eases it to mid on.
Slightly shorter outside off, Roy cuts it hard but finds the fielder at point.
Nicely played! Makes use of his feet and works it through wide mid on for a brace.
Tosses it up on off, Roy with the turn works it to mid on.
Full, on middle and off and driven to mid on for another single.
FOUR! Oh dear me! Roy is punishing Neser and punishing him hard. Stays back in his crease and punches the back of a length ball through the cover-point region for third boundary of the over.
FOUR! Easy peasy for Roy and poor from Neser again. Gets another one on pads and flicks it to square leg for another four.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
FOUR! He is racing away here. Neser is doing him favors here. Clips the back of a length ball to the square leg region and picks up a boundary.
Waits for the good length ball to come to him and punches it through the mid off region. One run added to the total.
Drives this one though mid on and takes the strike for the next over.
Lots of rips on this, Roy keeps it from the back foot.
Straighter on around middle and off, Roy wrists it away to the on side for nothing.
Tossed up outside off, Jonny gets back in his crease and tucks it fine behind point. The fielder runs after it and saves a run for his team.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Nice. Its not all power with Bairstow. He chops the flighted delivery around off and finds the fence through cover-point for a boundary.
Nathan Lyon is the first change.
The batsman has punched that ball through the offside.
On to the pads, on a fullish length and worked to the square leg region for a brace.
Similar line and length and Roy gets an under edge this time but straight to the keeper.
Too adventurous from Jason. Another full ball outside off and he throw his hands at it but misses the ball. No harm done in the end.
Around off and driven back to the bowler.
The batsman drives this through the covers. One run added to the total.
FOUR! AAH! Too straight billy, too straight! Strays on the pads and Roy is happy to flick it through the square leg region for another boundary.
FOUR! Smashed this one. Roy is relentless with these full deliveries outside off. He creams another one through covers and collects a boundary.
Hangs back and defends the good length delivery for nothing.
On a good length into the stumps, Roy keeps it out.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

SIX! Top edge and over the fence. Billy tests him with a good bouncer into the body and Roy swivels for the pull. He is late on it and the ball goes in the air off the top edge. The fielder at short fine leg runs after it but had no chance. First biggie of the innings goes to Jason Roy.
Looking to force the full ball through covers but couldn't pierce the gap. Good end to the over.
Straighter delivery on the stumps, the batsman looks to clip it off his pads but hits it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket.
On a good length and just kicks up and hits the thigh pad of hopping Bairstow.
Another full ball into the stumps and driven to the mid off region for nothing.
FOUR! OH Man! Bairstow is oozing class at the moment. Neser dishes it full in search of some swing but there's none. An easy half volley on a driveable length and four runs added to the total.
Full and driven off the front foot for nothing.
